summary: VIN Reports Jan-2026 changes tested (backend + frontend). Makes catalog merge works — Suzuki, all 12 admin makes, Porsche & Ferrari present. Available reports for Suzuki includes vin_history and kredo_cartrust. CarTrust valid submission returns async_pending=true with status=pending as designed, and regression vin_history still completes end-to-end. Frontend flow verified end-to-end: dealer login → /vin-reports/new → make picker shows Suzuki → BMW select → CarTrust row + inline plate/mileage inputs render → valid submit produces 'CarTrust order placed' async notice and navigates to the pending-order view. HOWEVER one HIGH backend bug found: POST /api/vin-reports/order for kredo_cartrust returns 502 (via Cloudflare 'Bad gateway' HTML page) instead of 400 when registration_number or mileage are missing/invalid — root cause is that the HTTPException(400) raised inside the vendor-dispatch try/except in routes/vin_reports.py is caught by `except HTTPException as e` and coerced into `HTTPException(502, 'Report failed: ...')`.

critical.issue: Missing registration_number OR mileage<=0 returns 502 (Cloudflare wraps FastAPI's 502 into a Bad Gateway HTML page) instead of the expected 400 with 'Registration number is required' / 'A valid mileage (km) is required'. Root cause: the HTTPException(400) raised inside the CarTrust branch (routes/vin_reports.py lines 296-300) is caught by the outer `except HTTPException as e: error = str(...)` block (lines 351-353), then rethrown as HTTPException(502, f'Report failed: {error}') at line 369. The 400 validation should either happen BEFORE the try/except, or the except HTTPException handler should re-raise 4xx exceptions unchanged.

action_items: Fix routes/vin_reports.py CarTrust validation: hoist the registration_number / mileage validation OUT of the vendor-dispatch try/except so HTTPException(400) propagates correctly. Suggested patch: perform the plate + mileage checks after `entry = _catalog_entry(...)` and before `await db.vin_report_orders.insert_one(base_row)`. Alternatively, change the outer `except HTTPException as e:` clause to `if e.status_code < 500: raise` before assigning to `error`.
Re-run test_vin_reports_cartrust.py::TestCarTrustOrderValidation to confirm both missing_registration and zero_mileage cases return 400 with the intended message.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/vin_reports.py: the outer `except HTTPException` at line 351 swallows and mis-classifies caller-side 4xx errors as vendor 502s. Any future validation raised inside the vendor branch will suffer the same fate.
routes/vin_reports.py list_supported_makes: merge logic looks correct; case-insensitive dedupe against Outvin + Porsche + Ferrari. Verified 79 makes returned in prod-like env.

frontend/app/(app)/vin-reports/new.tsx: the modal's `paddingTop: Platform.OS === 'ios' ? insets.top : 0` correctly protects iOS notch; verified in web preview the X close button sits at y≈26 (title y≈32) — safe on Android/web (no inset) and will offset on iOS builds.

rca_of_issue: BUG: 4xx validation errors from CarTrust dispatch are converted to 502. Reproduce: POST /api/vin-reports/order with report_type=kredo_cartrust and no registration_number (or mileage=0). Expected 400 'Registration number is required to order a CarTrust report.' — Actual 502 (Cloudflare Bad Gateway HTML). Backend log confirms FastAPI returned 502 (not upstream failure). Trace: routes/vin_reports.py line 296 raises HTTPException(400) → line 351 `except HTTPException as e` catches it and sets `error = 'Registration number is required...'` → line 358-369 stamps status=failed and raises HTTPException(502, f'Report failed: {error}'). Mitigation: move plate/mileage validation before the try block, or narrow the except to `except HTTPException as e: if e.status_code >= 500: error = ...; else: raise`.
